mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_step (session_id, round_no, step_order, step_type, input_data, output_data, status, error_message, duration_ms) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{roundNo}, #{stepOrder}, #{stepType}, #{inputData}, #{outputData}, #{status}, #{errorMessage}, #{durationMs})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM analysis_step WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND round_no = #{roundNo}
mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id, round_no, step_order, step_type, input_data, output_data, status, error_message, duration_ms, create_time FROM analysis_step WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY round_no, step_order
